ledger_name: ArcheAxis Knowledge — Open Source Absorption Decision Ledger
product_boundary: Local-first, evidence-driven Human–AI Learning & Knowledge Workspace. NOT an Agent OS, Cognitive OS, RAG platform, or Agent runtime.

disposition_labels.CURRENT: Already integrated — source/binary evidence exists. State qualified by tier below.
disposition_labels.ADOPT_PRODUCT_BASE: Run as the downstream learning product shell; ArcheAxis keeps all authority objects and truth.
disposition_labels.ADOPT: Recommended primary choice for the capability. Requires exact-revision RDR before integration.
disposition_labels.EVALUATE: Bake-off candidate — compare against peers with fixed fixtures before selecting.
disposition_labels.SIDECAR: Isolated, removable, not a default core dependency. Separate compliance path.
disposition_labels.REFERENCE: UX, contract, algorithm, or test-design reference only. Not a dependency.
disposition_labels.DEFER: Valuable for later horizons (H6+). Not for H0-H5 core.
disposition_labels.REVIEW-BLOCK: License, model, security, or product-boundary gate not passed. Default disabled.
disposition_labels.REJECT-CORE: Incompatible with product scope. Historical record preserved; not in dependency graph.

note: This ledger encodes ABSORPTION DECISIONS, not just registration. Each entry is the result of analysis against license, capability fit, product boundary, and upstream state as of 2026-08-11. Code license and model/weight license are kept separate. 'RDR-REQUIRED' means exact tag/commit + license file hash + Windows probe + fixture must be recorded before claiming integrated status.

components.name: PDF.js
components.evidence: Vendored ESM build + worker; package-data and fail-closed browser options tested; exact browser smoke pending current tree
components.decision: Upgrade to current fixed 6.2.108 line. Load as same-origin ES module; disable eval and document scripting. NOTICE and SBOM component required.
components.upstream_note: 6.2.108 includes the 2026 sandbox-escape advisory fix; archive/npm integrity recorded by project task evidence.

components.name: MarkItDown[pdf]
components.decision: Lightweight baseline for text-native PDF and Office. Disable default LLM OCR. pdfminer-six/pdfplumber/pypdfium2 transitive deps recorded separately.
components.upstream_note: MIT; optional [docx] group requires separate python-docx decision.

components.name: Trafilatura
components.decision: Must lock to modern Apache-2.0 versions (>=1.8). Older versions were GPL-3.0+. Add source-snapshot evidence.
components.upstream_note: License changed at 1.8 from GPL-3.0+ to Apache-2.0. Verify locked version.

components.name: pytesseract + Tesseract-OCR
components.evidence: Real-image gate; honest unavailable when Tesseract absent
components.decision: Baseline OCR. Language packs and Windows binary qualified separately. Not a complete H2 conversion loop yet — EvidenceAnchor per page/block still needed.
components.upstream_note: 100+ languages via tessdata. Windows packageable.

components.name: Crawl4AI
components.decision: Dynamic page sidecar ONLY. Never a default always-on crawler. SSRF/sandbox/snapshot/prompt-injection gates required before any automated use. Does not grant external content 'truth' identity.
components.upstream_note: Apache-2.0.

components.name: LiteLLM
components.decision: Thin provider adapter only. Core MIT; enterprise/ directory is separately licensed. Must not own business objects, data model, or auth state. Replaceable.
components.upstream_note: Default branch != stable release; lock to exact release tag. Enterprise dir is NOT MIT.

components.name: Langfuse
components.decision: Payload-safe local fallback required. EE/ directory is separately licensed. Redact secrets and PII before any trace export.
components.upstream_note: Core MIT; ee/ dir separately licensed. NOT overall MIT.

components.name: sqlite-vec
components.decision: Optional derived index. FTS5 always available as independent fallback. Vector index can be deleted and rebuilt. Only switch to LanceDB if scale/corpus proves FTS5+sqlite-vec insufficient.
components.upstream_note: Dual-license files; verify exact grant.

components.name: NetworkX
components.decision: Derived local graph projection only. Not a second truth layer. Kùzu archived — not a replacement candidate.
components.upstream_note: Kùzu upstream archived 2025-10-10; do not select as primary.

components.name: Loguru
components.decision: Retain. Logs must never contain secret plaintext, credentials, internal absolute paths. Converge with structlog to avoid dual-framework duplication.

components.name: structlog
components.decision: Converge responsibilities with Loguru — avoid maintaining two active log frameworks. One should be deprecated or scoped.

components.name: APScheduler
components.decision: Retain existing narrow responsibility. Do not expand into workflow-orchestration territory (Temporal/Prefect/Airflow deferred).

components.name: Magika
components.decision: Route-only; not a security proof. Small local model, 200+ types. Bake-off against existing stdlib/libmagic.

components.name: PaddleOCR
components.decision: Strongest Chinese/mixed candidate. Bake-off against Tesseract/EasyOCR/RapidOCR on fixed Chinese/English scanned corpus. VLM (PP-OCRv5) NOT default.
components.upstream_note: Code Apache-2.0; model weights recorded per-model.

components.name: EasyOCR
components.decision: Bake-off candidate. Compare against Tesseract/PaddleOCR/RapidOCR on fixed fixtures. Do not select by reputation alone.

components.name: RapidOCR
components.decision: Windows/CPU/ONNX potential. Model hash and derivation chain must pass review before selection.
components.upstream_note: Derived models — verify right chain.

components.name: faster-whisper
components.decision: Primary local ASR candidate. CTranslate2-based, quantized, no API key. Compare WER/RAM/latency against whisper.cpp on fixed Chinese/English corpus.
components.upstream_note: Code MIT; Whisper weights MIT. Separate qualification from other ASR candidates.

components.name: whisper.cpp
components.decision: CPU/quantized/offline ASR alternative. Independent implementation from faster-whisper — use as bake-off partner and low-resource fallback.
components.upstream_note: GGML models — each model's license recorded separately.

components.name: sherpa-onnx
components.decision: Multi-platform/offline streaming ASR. Evaluate for specific language/streaming scenarios. Each model registered individually.

components.name: Silero VAD
components.decision: Local small model. Reduces silent-segment inference and hallucination. Retain timeline for EvidenceAnchor.

components.name: Docling
components.decision: Complex document pages only (tables, formulas, multi-column). Code MIT; models licensed independently. Pass model SBOM + Windows qualification before use. NOT a default all-document engine.
components.upstream_note: Per-model license audit required.

components.name: Apache Tika
components.decision: Legacy/rare format rescue sidecar. Java 17+ dependency, subcomponent licenses shown separately. Not a primary engine; does not replace main conversion chain.
components.upstream_note: 1000+ formats. Java sidecar — resource/capability probe required.

components.name: Mozilla Readability
components.decision: Second-result fallback when Trafilatura fails or produces high-difference output. Output must still be sanitized (HTML is untrusted).

components.name: Crawlee Python
components.decision: Alternative dynamic page sidecar to Crawl4AI. Used only when static extraction is insufficient and user has authorized. Not a default always-on crawler.

components.name: JiWER
components.decision: Transparent CER/WER computation. ONLY compute when truth/prediction pairs exist. Never report CER/WER from engine confidence alone.

components.name: RapidFuzz
components.decision: Candidate text alignment and difference localization. Does NOT arbitrate factual correctness. Used to locate DisagreementSpan positions.

components.name: py-fsrs
components.decision: Interval/scheduling for learning cards. Each card must point back to an EvidenceAnchor. H4 target.

components.name: JSON Canvas
components.decision: Open file format, not a library dependency. Unknown fields preserved on roundtrip. H3 target.

components.name: XYFlow
components.decision: Canvas/Graph visualization. MIT license. File truth remains JSON Canvas. H3 target.

components.name: Crossref REST
components.decision: DOI/author/title/journal metadata. Public/polite pool. Read rate/concurrency headers; 429 backoff.
components.upstream_note: API, not a library.

components.name: DataCite REST
components.decision: DataCite DOI and dataset metadata. Open metadata; preserve provenance.
components.upstream_note: API, not a library.

components.name: OpenAlex
components.decision: Academic entity/citation graph. Freemium — free daily allowance, record service-side cost/caching. API key required.
components.upstream_note: API; cost model changes — monitor.

components.name: Wikidata
components.decision: Public entity/identifier/relationship queries. Narrow queries only. User-Agent/429/Retry-After. No fuzzy full-text verification.
components.upstream_note: SPARQL/wbgetentities. NOT for full-text search.

components.name: Syft
components.decision: SBOM generation. Bound to build artifact. H5 release qualification.

components.name: pip-audit
components.decision: Python dependency vulnerability scan. Part of minimum supply-chain toolset.

components.name: Gitleaks
components.decision: Secret scanning. CI/release tool. NOT packaged into product.

components.name: MinerU
components.decision: Apache-2.0 + additional MAU/revenue threshold and online-service identification obligations. NOT equal to plain Apache-2.0. Default disabled until owner/legal review.
components.upstream_note: Custom conditions in LICENSE.md — do NOT describe as 'Apache-2.0'.

components.name: PyMuPDF4LLM
components.decision: AGPL-3.0. Must explicitly accept AGPL combination obligations or purchase commercial license before any use.
components.upstream_note: Do not use under 'personal/non-profit exemption' assumption.

components.name: Marker
components.decision: CODE is Apache-2.0 (CORRECTED from old GPL-3.0 conclusion). WEIGHTS are modified OpenRAIL-M — separate review required. Do not select as default. Corrects historical 'code GPL' error.
components.upstream_note: code/weight license split; old GPL-3.0 record is WRONG.

components.name: FunASR / SenseVoice
components.decision: Code MIT. MODEL license has behavioral clauses, auto-revision terms, and undefined jurisdiction. Not a default component. Review per specific model.
components.upstream_note: Separate code vs model license — model terms are the blocker.

components.name: tldraw
components.decision: License requires a key for production use. NOT an open-source default component. Defer to H7+ as a commercial option.
components.upstream_note: Dev environment OK; production requires license key. Do not treat as OSS.

components.name: Firecrawl
components.decision: Main service is AGPL-3.0. SDK/UI portions may be MIT — component-level review required. NOT a default embedded dependency. Remote service or AGPL sidecar only.
components.upstream_note: AGPL main; some SDK/UI MIT. Do not summarize as one license.

components.name: H5P PHP Library
components.decision: GPL-3.0 (due to HTML Purifier dependency). Old 'core MIT' conclusion is WRONG. Content types licensed individually. Copyleft sidecar or content exchange only.
components.upstream_note: Corrects historical MIT assumption.

components.name: Phoenix (Arize)
components.decision: Elastic License 2.0 — source-available, NOT open-source. Do not list as default OSS dependency. Reference only or independent deployment for evaluation.
components.upstream_note: Do not write as 'OSS'. ELv2.

components.name: SearXNG
components.decision: AGPL-3.0. Optional sidecar for self-hosted search discovery. Cannot embed and claim permissive license.

components.name: DeepTutor
components.model_license: provider/model specific; no model weights vendored
components.product_path: external source body; project adapter under app/adapters/deeptutor
components.decision: Install and run as a replaceable downstream product shell. Its KB, memory, users, sessions and indexes are projections only; it cannot write Source/Anchor/Claim/Evidence/HumanLearning/MachineCompetence truth.
components.upstream_note: Release v1.5.17 published 2026-08-24; Windows fixes included. Golden workflow and restart/rebuild evidence remain required before installed/release qualification.

components.name: Kùzu
components.decision: Upstream archived 2025-10-10 (read-only). Must not be selected as primary graph component. Remove from active candidate list.
components.upstream_note: ARCHIVED.
